_comment: The one place the engine CLIs baked into the Sagax server image are pinned.
Read by scripts/install-engines.mjs (the Dockerfile's engines step), by the
manifest the install step writes) and by Perspicax's infra/scripts/build-push.sh.
Bump a version and its hashes together; docs/custom-engines.md lists the set.
redistributable false: the vendor's licence is not an open-source one, so the
engine is installed only in an image you build for your own servers
(ENGINE_SET=all), never in the public image (ENGINE_SET=open or none).

engines.name: Grok Build
engines._note: xAI publishes no checksum file: these hashes were taken from the artifacts whose MD5 matched the origin bucket's x-goog-hash.

engines.name: Cursor Agent
engines._note: The package https://cursor.com/install downloads; Cursor publishes no checksum, the hashes are of the artifacts fetched on 2026-10-08.

engines.name: Hermes Agent
engines._note: Release v2026.9.24 (Hermes 0.21.5) from its source archive: PyPI stops at 0.19.0 and the official install.sh clones main with uv and asks questions.

notPreinstalled.name: Cline
notPreinstalled.reason: Added upstream in 0.1.107+ (native ACP); it is not verified to withhold its own shell and file tools (scripts/verify-org-host-tools.ts), so organization turns are refused (409 host_tools) and the server image does not carry it yet.

notPreinstalled.name: Muse Code
notPreinstalled.reason: Added upstream in 0.1.107+ (Muse Code SDK); it is not verified to withhold its own shell and file tools (scripts/verify-org-host-tools.ts), so organization turns are refused (409 host_tools) and the server image does not carry it yet.

notPreinstalled.name: Antigravity
notPreinstalled.reason: Google's runtime is about 2 GB unpacked under Google's own terms, and Sagax already downloads and verifies it itself (Settings, managed install) where it can run; on an organization server it runs its own tools on the Sagax host, so organization turns are refused anyway.

notPreinstalled.name: MiniMax CLI (mmx)
notPreinstalled.reason: Not needed: the MiniMax engine calls the MiniMax API with the key saved in Settings or MINIMAX_API_KEY; mmx-cli is only a sign-in helper and publishes no licence.
